# Homelab Applications

> The applications running on the Flatcar homelab cluster: what they are, where their state lives, and the conventions every one of them follows.

One page per application deployed by Argo CD from this repository onto the
Flatcar homelab cluster, plus the conventions every one of them follows. The
platform underneath is documented at https://homelab.wlkr.ch/.

## Conventions

- [Home](<https://homelab-apps.wlkr.ch/index.md>)
- [Conventions](<https://homelab-apps.wlkr.ch/conventions/index.md>)
- [Pull request previews](<https://homelab-apps.wlkr.ch/previews/index.md>)
- [Claude agents](<https://homelab-apps.wlkr.ch/claude-agents/index.md>)
